notes: brand/ sits at the repository root beside media/, which keeps its live card URLs and its README. The root is the site, so if the deploy uploads the repository root (as .wrangler/ in .gitignore suggests), brand/ would be served at /brand/ unless the upload leaves it out. Which upload serves the site is not recorded, so there is no exclude file to name yet. The repository is public under CC BY-SA 4.0 either way.
